source: sealed LUDB 1.0.1 and original label-free P8/P4 routing, previously inspected; retrospective

morphology.selection: first 16 scored keys in ascending SHA-256 order with prefix titan-morph-trace-v1; selected without references
morphology.precision: fixed float32 reconstructed route; identical execution repeated; historical P4 tolerance unchanged at 0.00001; perturbations are not fitted to historical scores

fallback.eligibility: all original joint abstentions, excluding technical failures; no reference-driven gating
fallback.model: actual V3F plus released P6 head on withheld ECGs only; remove the P8 head before fallback
fallback.decision: published P6 thresholds for AFIB SB STACH RBBB 1AVB PVC; no further top-1 fallback; P8 NSR/PAC and all P4 outcomes remain unresolved
fallback.evaluation: known-reference opportunity denominator and full ECG denominator kept; count errors corrected and introduced versus withheld counterfactual P8 predictions; compare with baseline and joint withholding
fallback.limits: partial experimental cascade; timing on one allocation is not a clinical or production estimate; no model training or release
